zh.title: 達美航空A330neo在特拉維夫機場（TLV）遭炸彈威脅後隔離
zh.summary: 達美航空A330neo在特拉維夫遭炸彈威脅後隔離，檢查未發現可信威脅。
body: Simple Flying報導，達美航空（Delta）一架空中巴士A330neo在特拉維夫機場因炸彈威脅而遭隔離。報導摘要指出，威脅促使撤離及安全檢查，並稱未發現可信威脅。
報導所述的處置包括飛機隔離、撤離與安全檢查；摘要提及，炸彈威脅引發了這些應對措施。檢查結果則是未發現可信威脅。這是目前報導摘要所述的事件經過與結果。

en.title: Delta A330neo Isolated at Tel Aviv Airport (TLV) After Bomb Threat
en.summary: Delta isolated its A330neo at Tel Aviv after a threat; no credible threat was found.
body: Simple Flying reported that Delta's Airbus A330neo was isolated at Tel Aviv Airport (TLV) after a bomb threat. The summary says the threat prompted an evacuation and a security inspection. It also states that no credible threat was found.

The reported response involved isolation of the aircraft, an evacuation and a security inspection. The summary links those actions to the bomb threat and gives the assessment that no credible threat was found. The account describes the aircraft's isolation and the resulting security response, with no credible threat identified in the stated outcome.

zh.title: 義大利空軍訂購六架Astore Levante武裝無人機
zh.summary: 義大利空軍訂購六架Astore Levante武裝無人機，合約分為三套系統
body: 義大利空軍已向由義大利Leonardo與土耳其Baykar成立的合資企業LBA Systems訂購六架Astore Levante武裝無人機。AeroTime報導引述義大利空軍參謀長Antonio Conserva將軍於2026年10月12日確認這項採購。
合約涵蓋三套系統，每套包含兩架無人機，並有一座可操作兩架無人機的地面控制站。報導指出，合約金額尚未披露；認證預計在2026年底至2027年初之間進行。

en.title: Italian Air Force orders six Astore Levante armed drones
en.summary: Italian Air Force orders six Astore Levante drones in three two-aircraft systems.
body: The Italian Air Force has ordered six Astore Levante armed drones from LBA Systems, the joint venture between Italy’s Leonardo and Turkey’s Baykar. AeroTime reports that Italian Air Force Chief of Staff General Antonio Conserva confirmed the acquisition on October 12, 2026, citing Italian defense magazine Rivista Italiana Difesa (RID).

The contract covers three systems, with two aircraft in each system, and one ground control station capable of operating both drones. Its value has not been disclosed. Certification is expected between late 2026 and early 2027, according to the report.

zh.title: Air Tahiti接收全商務艙ATR 72-600客機
zh.summary: Air Tahiti接收全商務艙ATR 72-600，首批商業航班預定12月8日啟航
body: Air Tahiti已接收一架配備ATR HighLine全商務艙的ATR 72-600。ATR於2026年10月13日確認，該機將自2026年12月8日起，在法屬玻里尼西亞羣島間執行首批商業航班。
客艙設有26個座位，採1-1配置，所有乘客均可直接通往走道。ATR表示，這架飛機將支援推出Air Tahiti Signature高端服務，連結大溪地及法屬玻里尼西亞部分目的地，包括波拉波拉島與Raiatea-Tahaa。Air Tahiti計畫以該機執飛定期航班及包機任務。

en.title: Air Tahiti takes delivery of all-business ATR 72-600
en.summary: Air Tahiti takes delivery of an all-business ATR 72-600, with first commercial flights planned from December 8.
body: Air Tahiti has taken delivery of a new ATR 72-600 fitted with ATR’s HighLine All-Business Class cabin. ATR confirmed on October 13, 2026, that the aircraft will operate its first commercial flights among the islands of French Polynesia from December 8, 2026.

The cabin has 26 seats in a 1-by-1 configuration, with direct aisle access for every passenger. According to ATR, the aircraft will support the launch of Air Tahiti Signature, a premium service intended to connect Tahiti with destinations including Bora Bora and Raiatea-Tahaa. Air Tahiti plans to use the aircraft on scheduled flights and charter missions.

zh.title: MARSS與科威特簽約提供全國反無人機防禦系統
zh.summary: MARSS與科威特簽約提供全國反無人機防禦系統，納入硬殺傷攔截器。
body: AeroTime報導，MARSS已與科威特簽署價值£370 million（$489 million）的合約，提供全國性反無人機防禦系統，並納入硬殺傷攔截器。MARSS於2026年10月12日表示，系統將涵蓋來自空中與海上的威脅。光電、雷達及聲納感測器將設置於一系列地點，並把資料傳送至中央指揮中心。
MARSS表示，將部署以NiDAR為核心的蜂巢式系統；NiDAR是該公司的人工智慧指揮與控制系統，設計用於多領域監視及反無人機防禦。公司表示，將在未來24個月整合感測器與效應器。這項與科威特的協議屬於英國政府Taskforce Sabre的一部分；該計畫結合政府與產業，協助海灣國家取得所需系統。

en.title: MARSS signs Kuwait contract for nationwide counter-drone defense system
en.summary: MARSS signs a Kuwait contract for nationwide counter-drone defenses with hard-kill interceptors
body: AeroTime reported that MARSS signed a £370 million ($489 million) contract with Kuwait to provide a nationwide counter-drone defense system that includes hard-kill interceptors. On October 12, 2026, MARSS said the system would cover threats from the air and the sea. Electro-optical, radar and sonar sensors installed across a network of sites will feed central command centers.

MARSS said it will deploy a cellular system built around NiDAR, its AI-enabled command and control system designed for multi domain surveillance and counter-drone defense. The company said it will integrate the sensors and effectors over the coming 24 months. The agreement forms part of the UK government’s Taskforce Sabre, which brings together government and industry to help Gulf states rapidly secure the systems they need.

zh.title: EASA更新Organisation Approval Tool指引，PDF手冊取代訓練影片
zh.summary: EASA以PDF手冊取代工具訓練影片，手冊可於官網取得
body: EASA更新Organisation Approval Tool的使用指引，將先前發布於YouTube的訓練影片改為PDF使用手冊。EASA表示，組織可直接在其網站的EASA Organisation Approval Tool頁面取得手冊。
這些PDF手冊是使用該工具的組織取得指引的主要來源。EASA提醒使用者參閱其網站，以確認所查看的是最新版本；該更新也為各地組織提供集中取得最新指引的管道。

en.title: EASA Replaces Organisation Approval Tool Training Videos With PDF Manuals
en.summary: EASA replaces training videos with PDF manuals available on its Organisation Approval Tool page.
body: EASA has replaced training videos previously hosted on YouTube with PDF user manuals for organisations using its Organisation Approval Tool. The manuals are available directly from the EASA Organisation Approval Tool page on the agency’s website.

EASA says the PDF manuals serve as the primary guidance for organisations using the tool. It advises users to consult the EASA website to make sure they have the latest version. The update provides organisations worldwide with a central location to access the guidance.
